import.title: Bulk Import Employees
import.description: Upload a CSV file, or paste the content directly. The header row must include "姓名、員工編號、部門、職位、電子郵件、到職日" (name, employee ID, department, position, email, join date); phone, address, notes, monthly salary, and annual leave days used are optional. A login account is created automatically for each employee (username = email, default password = employee ID).
